description: After Stage 5 pushes, the final-head CI check in flow/github/ci_final_head.py (_wait_for_pr_head) polls the pull request object until its head equals the pushed commit, for up to the CI registration timeout (180 s by default). Twice the wait ran out with 'the PR head did not match the pushed head before the registration wait ran out' and the flow ended with CI on its final head unverified ('unknown') after waiting three minutes, even though the check runs for the pushed commit may already have been running.
goal: The final-head check no longer waits on the pull request object catching up: it proceeds to probe the check runs of the pushed commit itself, so a lagging pull request head does not hide checks that are already registered. When no checks have registered for the pushed commit, it retries once with a fresh read before reporting unknown, and the unknown reason says which case occurred (pull request head lagging versus no checks registered). An unknown result is reported at once as a failure to verify and is never folded into a success. The module line budgets are frozen: do not edit holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json or any budget-check script, and keep every touched module within its current budget.
rationale: The wait on the pull request head is the avoidable part of the three-minute stall; the commit's own check runs are authoritative, so probing them directly removes the idle time and the spurious unknown without changing the CI wait policy used elsewhere.
acceptance_criteria: With a pull request head that never matches the pushed head but check runs already present for the pushed commit, the final-head check returns the real CI outcome for the pushed commit without waiting out the registration timeout.

When no checks are registered for the pushed commit, the check does one retry with a fresh read and then reports 'unknown' with a reason that distinguishes 'pull request head lagged the pushed head' from 'no checks registered for the pushed head'.
An 'unknown' result is returned immediately to the caller as a failure to verify and is never reported as success.
The existing public names of ci_final_head.py (including BOOKKEEPING_PATH_PREFIXES) and the behaviour of flow/github/ci.py are unchanged; no other source file changes.

A new test file apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/github/test_ci_final_head_registration.py covers the lagging head with registered checks, the single retry, and both unknown reasons, using the existing injected seams and a fake clock so no real time passes; it fails on the old code and passes on the new.
The module budgets file and every budget-check script are untouched and every touched module stays within its current line budget.
uv run pytest passes for apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/github and the existing final-head tests.
